title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only, immutable audit record. All six fields mandated by Constitution IX are required; POL-AUD-001 asserts their presence as a mandatory release-blocking policy check.

runId.description: Correlation identifier propagated across logs, metrics, traces and state.

actorType.description: Mandatory field 1. 'system' covers pre-approved policy action such as retention-driven abandonment, which is never an approval.

affectedArtifact.description: Mandatory field 4: the artifact or state affected.

reason.description: Mandatory field 6. Never empty — an unexplained audit record is not auditable.

executorModeUsed.description: Required on any event describing a stage execution. A deterministic execution is never presented as AI work (NFR-AUT-003).

correctsEventId.description: Corrections are appended, never applied in place. Points at the record being corrected.
